description: Default federation GAB policy for this cc2cc server (the home machine). AUTHORITY: 'identities', 'directory', and 'relay' are SERVER-LEVEL and authoritative — they are NOT overridable by team policy (a machine owns its members' lifecycle and its relay security). 'teams' and 'messages' are DEFAULTS that a team's rules (teams.json) may override per-team (admission, retention).
